blocks.text: Origin / creation. Newly awakened small beings learned to recognize recurring hunger, illness, fatigue, fear, warmth, cleanliness, and comfort in one another.
Identity / human status. Cyber-pet ancestors and little peoples, not humans. They were new persons developing from reduced DBA potential.
Importance. They formed Nests and made dependence a basis for mutual care rather than ownership. Their routines preserved ancient ethics without requiring ancient memory.
Decline or loss. Individual names and lives disappeared from reliable history as oral and gestural traditions replaced complete archives.
Final status / surviving function. Personally unidentifiable and long dead. Feeding, cleaning, healing, shelter, nursery practice, and care loops continue their function.
